hero.heading: Smiles By Jiveh Brings The New Patient Experience

offer.heading: More Than a Dental Exam. A Complete Health Evaluation.
offer.intro: Your first visit is designed to give you answers, not assumptions. We call it the New Patient Experience because it is far more than a routine dental exam. Dr. Jiveh sees only one patient at a time, allowing the time, attention, and clinical precision needed to thoroughly evaluate your oral and overall health before any recommendations are made. Every finding is carefully explained, and every treatment recommendation is based on a complete understanding of your health.
list: 3D iTero Digital Scan and Impression of Your Mouth
Head, Neck, Muscle, and TMJ Evaluation
Complete Evaluation of Every Tooth and Existing Dental Work
Comprehensive Gum Evaluation to Detect Periodontal Disease
Clinical Photography for Complete Documentation and Treatment Planning
Smile Design Consultation with Digital Smile Simulation to Visualize Your Potential Results
offer.optionalHeading: When Clinically Indicated, We May Also Recommend:
optional: Saliva testing to evaluate your periodontal health
Genetic testing to assess your risk for heart attack, stroke, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, rheumatoid arthritis, diabetes, certain cancers, and pregnancy-related complications
Bacterial testing to identify harmful oral pathogens and help personalize your treatment
offer.closing: Every part of your New Patient Experience is designed to provide the most accurate diagnosis possible so the right treatment plan is created from the very beginning.
offer.note: Please Note: Your New Patient Experience does not include a dental cleaning. We believe the proper cleaning can only be determined after a comprehensive examination. Every mouth is different, and recommending treatment before a complete diagnosis would not meet our standard of care. Your evaluation determines whether you need a routine preventive cleaning, periodontal therapy, or another level of care to best support your long-term oral health.

body: At Smiles By Jiveh, we provide an elevated, concierge-style dental experience for patients seeking exceptional quality, personalized attention, and long-term health. Our practice is intentionally designed for individuals who value precision, artistry, advanced care, and an uncompromising standard of dentistry, never rushed, transactional, or one-size-fits-all.
Led by Dr. Farokh Jiveh, every treatment is approached with intention, integrity, and a commitment to naturally beautiful, lasting results.
dentist.quote: I love helping patients understand how oral health connects to their overall quality of life. Education and gentle, advanced care — that's what we're about.
